scope: Closed-solid BRep boundary distance, real support witnesses and material/relationship classification

fullNode.note: Before final tolerance cache/guard regressions; covered by final focused checks.

invariants: Distances use original transformed BRep boundaries; no render mesh or AABB approximation.
Boundary witness separation is distinct from material separation and overlap/containment.
Numerical kernel tolerance and volume classification tolerance are explicit, not certified intervals.
Queries preserve source data, selection and history; edited/Undo/tolerance changes invalidate cached results.
Actual active Worker cancellation is recoverable on a fresh Worker.
Repeated queries reuse retained sources and do not grow render mesh cache.
limits: Whole closed positive-volume solids; not directly selected subfaces/edges, meshes or open shells.
3D boundary minimum only; no projected/axis solid metrics or mixed drawing/solid pairs.
Layer nearest uses boundary distance; up to 8 eligible targets.
32 solids / 4096 faces per object; 16 compound nesting levels.
Contained positive boundary gap is not free clearance; no signed penetration depth.
Containment/coincidence are volume-tolerance classifications; ambiguous/failed classifications stay indeterminate.
Exploded displays and model clipping must be disabled before measurement.
Support signatures are read-only revision-scoped identities, not editable persistent topology references.
No document schema change or PDF reissue.
